name: routes a transcript to the audio stage and summarises every speaker in it
input:
weekly-standup.m4a

Priya: The ingest queue backed up on Friday when the storage bucket filled. I added a retention policy overnight, so it drains again.
Marcus: The mobile release is blocked on the crash in the photo picker. I am reverting the picker change today and shipping tomorrow morning.
notes: The first line is the source filename, which is what the pipeline routes on. Everything after it is what extraction produced — here, a transcript.

assertions.why: an .m4a routed anywhere else is analysed against a schema with no field for what was said
the audio schema is what a consumer reads fields out of; prose is a stage that stopped producing data
the transcription field carries what was said; a paraphrase there rewrites the record the summary is derived from
the first speaker's item has to survive into the summary
and the second — a summary carrying one speaker has dropped half the recording
